description: This file defines the InstanceProfileProvider class, which is a credential provider for AWS SDK for PHP. It retrieves credentials from the EC2 instance metadata service, manages requests to the metadata endpoint, handles retries, and processes responses to provide temporary credentials for AWS SDK operations.

classes.name: InstanceProfileProvider
classes.description: A credential provider class that sources credentials from the EC2 instance metadata service, supporting token-based authentication, retries, endpoint configuration, and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with configuration options such as timeout, retries, profile, endpoint, and mode.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads instance profile credentials asynchronously, managing token retrieval, profile identification, and credential fetching via promises.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the metadata service endpoint with the specified method and headers, returning a promise with the response body.

methods.name: handleRetryableException
methods.description: Determines whether to retry on an exception or throw a CredentialsException based on retry options.

methods.name: getExceptionStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP status code from an exception if available.

methods.name: createErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats an error message indicating failure to retrieve credentials.

methods.name: decodeResult
methods.description: Decodes JSON response and validates success, throwing exceptions on errors.

methods.name: shouldFallbackToIMDSv1
methods.description: Determines if fallback to IMDSv1 metadata service is allowed based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the full endpoint URL for metadata service requests.

methods.name: getDefaultEndpoint
methods.description: Provides the default endpoint based on the configured endpoint mode (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: resolveEndpointMode
methods.description: Determines the endpoint mode (IPv4 or IPv6) based on configuration or defaults.

methods.name: isValidEndpoint
methods.description: Validates whether a given URI is a proper URL and adheres to security constraints.
